_comment: Pre-registered parameters. Frozen on 2026-10-14 before any accuracy result exists. Changing any value after s05/s06/s07 have produced accuracy is a protocol deviation and must be logged in results/DEVIATIONS.md.

encoder.layer_convention: hidden_states[L] = raw output of transformer layer L (no final LayerNorm), transformers>=5

personalisation.primary_k_rule: largest k in k_values such that every speaker of the corpus keeps >= min_items_per_speaker items with >= k + min_test_per_item productions; decided by s01 from counts only, before any model runs
personalisation.split_rule: per item: shuffle with the seed, then stable-sort by session; first k = train, rest = test

lora.targets: q_proj, v_proj of all 24 attention layers

whisper.match_rule: closest item by difflib SequenceMatcher ratio on lower-case, accent-free text

hypotheses.H4_primary_comparison: frozen layer 12 1-NN vs fine-tune all layers at 10 epochs, primary k, per speaker, dysarthric and control separately (TORGO)

torgo.items: single-word prompts only (one token of letters, no brackets, no file paths)

changes: fine-tuning baselines extended from [full, top4] to [full, top4, lora, full_L12] after an adversarial review argued the comparison needed a parameter-efficient baseline and a fine-tuned model truncated at the same layer
splits are session-aware: within each item, training recordings are taken from the earliest sessions and test recordings from later ones, to limit same-session leakage
accuracy-vs-cost comparisons recompute cost for each corpus's recording lengths and training-set size
recordings shorter than 0.1 s after trimming are excluded (s01b), after one crashed the embedding stage

Whisper-medium baseline capped at 60 test recordings per speaker (was 200) because forced choice over up to 95 candidates took ~12 s per recording; Whisper is a secondary comparison and its partial output was not inspected
run order changed: fine-tuning (primary H4 comparison) runs before the Whisper baselines

amendments.note: after frozen-system accuracy existed (s05, first s08) but before it was inspected, and before any fine-tuning or Whisper accuracy
changes: recordings longer than 30 s after trimming are excluded (s01b --max-seconds 30): one 194 s TORGO file in speaker F03 made fine-tuning impossible (9.5 GiB buffer); s05 re-run on the new manifest
s07 resumable; a fine-tuning run that fails (e.g. out of memory) is logged in results/s07/<corpus>_finetune_failures.csv and retried once, never silently dropped
